# bintables/alloc

> Helper: the heap. `__pk_alloc` returns rdi bytes of zeroed memory in rax.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/alloc.pkg)

Included with `@alloc` by `new` and `make`. It is a bump allocator: it
hands out memory from a chunk obtained with `mmap` (64 MB, or more for a
larger request) and never frees it. Fresh `mmap` memory is zero, so
everything allocated starts out zeroed. Sizes are rounded up to 8 bytes.

Clobbers `rcx`, `rdx`, `rsi`, `rdi`, `r8`–`r11`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@panic
```

Includes: [bintables/panic](panic.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
__pk_alloc:
add rdi, 7
and rdi, -8
mov rax, [rel __pk_heap]
lea rdx, [rax+rdi]
cmp rdx, [rel __pk_heap_end]
ja .grow
mov [rel __pk_heap], rdx
ret
.grow:
push rdi
mov rsi, 67108864
cmp rdi, rsi
cmova rsi, rdi
push rsi
xor edi, edi
mov edx, 3
mov r10d, 34
mov r8, -1
xor r9d, r9d
mov eax, 9
syscall
pop rsi
pop rdi
test rax, rax
js __pk_panic_oom
lea rcx, [rax+rsi]
mov [rel __pk_heap_end], rcx
lea rdx, [rax+rdi]
mov [rel __pk_heap], rdx
ret
section .data
__pk_heap: dq 0
__pk_heap_end: dq 0
section .text
```
